date_note: ANP, on Binnenlands Bestuur, reported the municipality's press release on 18 November 2026; neither page gives an earlier day. Security.nl reported it on 19 November.
exec: A Dutch municipality says it unlawfully processed and shared personal data of just over 1,000 people for years; the data protection authority has been informed.
impact: Data of just over 1,000 people, per the municipality
plain: The city of Dordrecht says it handled personal data of just over 1,000 people unlawfully from 2018 to 2025 while tackling public nuisance, and has told the Dutch data protection authority.

sources.name: Binnenlands Bestuur (ANP): Gegevens 1000 inwoners Dordrecht jarenlang onwettig gedeeld
Security.nl: Dordrecht schond jarenlang privacy inwoners: gegevens illegaal verwerkt

summary: The municipality of Dordrecht says in a press release, reported by ANP and Security.nl, that it unlawfully processed and shared personal data of just over 1,000 residents between 2018 and 2025 while tackling public nuisance. Security.nl says the data included health, criminal records and sexual orientation. An independent investigation, started after a complaint, found the processing broke the law on several points. The Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens has been informed; Security.nl says it has started an investigation.
title: Dordrecht says it unlawfully processed sensitive data of just over 1,000 residents

validation.note: Binnenlands Bestuur (ANP wire, 18 Nov) and Security.nl (19 Nov) each report the municipality's statement on just over 1,000 residents; the data types and the AP investigation are stated by Security.nl only. The municipality's own release was not read.

evidence.quote: De gemeente Dordrecht heeft de persoonsgegevens van ruim duizend inwoners niet goed gedeeld, beschermd en bewaard.
Volgens de gemeente gaat het om de gegevens van ruim duizend mensen.
